name: Ushering
overview: Ushering in the church is a humble and vital service, reflecting the heart of serving God willingly and with good will, as Ephesians 6:7 teaches. Psalms 84:10 highlights the honor in being a doorkeeper in God's house, valuing this role above worldly pleasures. This service extends the hospitality of the church, distributing to the needs of the saints as Romans 12:13 instructs, and aligns with faithfully carrying out God's purposes as seen in Revelation 1:1. Ultimately, ushering is an act of devotion, opening doors for worship and ministry in the presence of the Lord.
